title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
factSummary: OpenAI announced visual, interactive Chat answers. Paid-tier rollout starts October 7; Free and Go start October 8. Enterprise access depends on administrators. Work and Codex models are unchanged.

title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
factSummary: College Planner is planned to organize application tasks and deadlines. It is coming soon without a launch date, initially for US grades 10–12 applying to four-year colleges; wider coverage is planned.
